text:
I had my wisdom tooth extracted here and was very impressed.
The doctor and all the staff were polite and attentive to customers. The clinic is new and clean.

Before the procedure, I told the doctor that I was afraid of anesthetic injections. The doctor understood and administered the injection very gently. The extraction itself was quick, painless, and didn't take long. There was no swelling or bruising afterward.

There's plenty of parking available in the market. Overall, I felt comfortable and confident with the treatment. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for a good dental clinic. 🙏🏻

text: 10/10/10 Excellent service! I was impressed from the moment I arrived. I had my wisdom tooth extracted. The facility is clean, the equipment is well-equipped, and they even follow up afterwards with great care. I highly recommend this clinic.
